plugins.name: crucible
plugins.description: A crucible does not make the thing; it applies enough heat that only what survives comes out. Splits building from judging across agents that can each overrule the other — the judge ships with Edit and Write absent from its tool list, so read-only is structural rather than a request. The builder may push back with evidence, and the judge records every requirement it withdrew. Optionally splits the judge into a left hemisphere for correctness and a right for whether a person can actually use the result.
